usage: This is the universal, everyday word for thank you in Morocco, used with anyone regardless of age or status. While shukran is standard, Moroccans often prefer religious phrases like bark llah fik for genuine favors to show warmer appreciation.

variants.label: very much
variants.note: Add bzaf to express stronger gratitude.

variants.label: polite/warm
variants.note: A very common and warmer alternative to a simple thank you.

variants.label: deep gratitude
variants.english: May God have mercy on your parents
variants.note: Use this when someone does you a significant favor.

variants.label: casual to a man
variants.note: Used casually with male peers, shopkeepers, or taxi drivers.

examples.english: Thank you very much, the food was delicious.
